raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On the comfy_kitchen INT8 backend, Qwen-Image 2.1's MLP ran three GEMMs plus a standalone SiLU-mul: `gate_layer`, `proj`, `silu(gate) * up` written to HBM in BF16, then `out`. ComfyUI runs the same checkpoint as one `[gate | up]` GEMM and a down-projection that applies the SwiGLU inside its quantizer (`int8_linear(..., input_act="swiglu")`).

## Modifications

- `convrot_int8_comfy_kitchen.py`: add `comfy_kitchen_swiglu_mlp`, which makes the two kitchen calls. The linear method's `apply` is unchanged.
- `qwen_image21.py`:
  - `pack_gate_up_weights()` runs from `post_load_weights` and from `_apply`, so packing survives `.to()` and CPU offload. It puts the `gate_layer`/`proj` INT8 weights and row scales into one storage each. This mirrors `pack_qkv_weights`: parameters keep their names and shapes, and no reference to the shared storage is kept.
  - `packed_gate_up()` re-derives the stacked views on every forward.
  - LoRA wrappers, layerwise-offload placeholders, TP > 1, torch.compile and the JIT backend keep the separate projections.

## Accuracy Tests

- The stacked GEMM computes the same per-column arithmetic as the two separate projections.
- The fused quantizer keeps `silu(gate) * up` in FP32 instead of rounding it to BF16 first, so outputs are **not bitwise** the previous path.
  - Against an FP32 reference, relative L2 error is 1.33% for the fused path vs 1.35% for eager at (2048, 3072→1024), and 1.44% vs 1.46% at (4096, 12288→4096).
  - It is the same call ComfyUI makes for this model.
- New unit test (`test_convrot_int8_backends.py`) checks:
  - the fused error vs FP32 is no worse than eager's;
  - re-packing after a CPU round trip;
  - the fallback is bitwise the eager path once the shared storage is gone.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Qwen-Image 2.1 INT8 checkpoint, comfy_kitchen backend, SGLD ComfyUI workflow, 8 steps × 3 seeds. Steady model-time gain:

| GPU | CFG 1 | CFG 4 |
|---|---:|---:|
| RTX 4090 | +4.75% | +4.46% |
| RTX 5090 | +4.44% | +4.16% |
| H200 (kitchen forced) | +3.17% | +2.46% |

H200, B200 and RTX 5090 default to the JIT backend, where this path is inactive. RTX 4090 (sm89) always uses comfy_kitchen.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

-__all__ = ["ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod"]
+__all__ = ["ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod", "comfy_kitchen_swiglu_mlp"]
 
 # comfy_kitchen's dtype codes for the fused op's output.
 _OUT_DTYPE_CODE = {torch.float32: 0, torch.float16: 1, torch.bfloat16: 2}
@@ -221,3 +221,37 @@ def run(rows: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         if len(orig_shape) != 2:
             out = out.reshape(*orig_shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])

+
+def comfy_kitchen_swiglu_mlp(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_up_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_up_group_size: int,
+    down: torch.nn.Module,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``down(silu(gate) * up)`` for ``[gate | up] = x @ gate_up_weight.T``, run as
+    ComfyUI runs SwiGLU MLPs: one GEMM over the stacked [gate; up] weight, and a
+    down-projection that applies the SwiGLU inside its quantizer
+    (``input_act="swiglu"``), so the activated rows never reach HBM.
+
+    The fused quantizer keeps ``silu(gate) * up`` in FP32 instead of rounding it
+    to BF16 first, so the result is not bitwise the eager form; it sits slightly
+    closer to an FP32 reference.
+    """
+    out_code = _OUT_DTYPE_CODE[x.dtype]
+    rows = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
+    gate_up = torch.ops.comfy_kitchen.int8_linear(
+        rows, gate_up_weight, gate_up_scale, None, out_code, True, gate_up_group_size
+    )
+    out = torch.ops.comfy_kitchen.int8_linear(
+        gate_up,
+        down.weight,
+        down.weight_scale,
+        None,
+        out_code,
+        True,  # convrot
+        down.quant_method.group_size,
+        "swiglu",
+    )
+    return out.reshape(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])

+def _stacked_rows(a, b):
+    """[a; b] as one view when ``b`` directly follows ``a`` in the same storage, else None."""
+    # Layerwise offload leaves a flat placeholder in place of each weight.
+    if not (
+        a.dim() == 2
+        and a.is_cuda
+        and a.shape == b.shape
+        and a.is_contiguous()
+        and b.is_contiguous()
+        and a.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == b.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+        and b.storage_offset() == a.storage_offset() + a.numel()
+    ):
+        return None
+    return a.as_strided((2 * a.shape[0], a.shape[1]), (a.shape[1], 1))

@@ -343,7 +363,72 @@ def __init__(self, dim, ratio, quant_config, prefix):
             prefix=f"{prefix}.out",
         )
 
+    def pack_gate_up_weights(self):
+        """Share one [2F, C] INT8 weight and [2F, 1] scale storage between gate_layer
+        and proj so the comfy_kitchen path projects both with one GEMM.
+
+        As with ``pack_qkv_weights``, parameters keep their names and shapes and
+        no reference to the shared storage is kept. Layers that are not plain
+        comfy_kitchen INT8 projections are left alone.
+        """
+        gate, up = self.gate_layer, self.proj
+        if self.packed_gate_up() is not None:
+            return
+        if not (
+            all(
+                type(layer) is ColumnParallelLinear
+                and isinstance(layer.quant_method, ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod)
+                and layer.weight.is_cuda
+                and layer.weight.dtype is torch.int8
+                and layer.weight.dim() == 2
+                for layer in (gate, up)
+            )
+            and gate.weight.shape == up.weight.shape
+            and gate.quant_method.group_size == up.quant_method.group_size
+        ):
+            return
+        rows = gate.weight.shape[0]
+        weight = torch.cat([gate.weight.data, up.weight.data], dim=0)
+        scale = torch.cat([gate.weight_scale.data, up.weight_scale.data], dim=0)
+        gate.weight.data, up.weight.data = weight[:rows], weight[rows:]
+        gate.weight_scale.data, up.weight_scale.data = scale[:rows], scale[rows:]
+
+    def packed_gate_up(self):
+        """The stacked [gate; up] weight and scale views when the comfy_kitchen
+        fused MLP can run, else None."""
+        gate, up, out = self.gate_layer, self.proj, self.out
+        # LoRA wrappers replace the layers; TP > 1 would need the down all-reduce.
+        if not (
+            type(gate) is ColumnParallelLinear
+            and type(up) is ColumnParallelLinear
+            and type(out) is RowParallelLinear
+            and out.tp_size == 1
+            and isinstance(gate.quant_method, ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod)
+            and isinstance(out.quant_method, ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod)
+            and out.weight.dtype is torch.int8
+        ):
+            return None
+        weight = _stacked_rows(gate.weight, up.weight)
+        scale = _stacked_rows(gate.weight_scale, up.weight_scale)
+        if weight is None or scale is None:
+            return None
+        return weight, scale
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse=True):
+        # .to() and CPU offload rebuild every parameter in its own storage;
+        # re-share them once the weights are back on the GPU.
+        module = super()._apply(fn, recurse)
+        self.pack_gate_up_weights()
+        return module

+        # separate projections.

+        if packed is not None:
+            return comfy_kitchen_swiglu_mlp(
+                x, *packed, self.gate_layer.quant_method.group_size, self.out
+            )

@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@
 )

     ConvRotInt8ComfyKitchenLinearMethod,
+    comfy_kitchen_available,
 )
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.convrot_int8_jit import (
     ConvRotInt8JitLinearMethod,
@@ -219,6 +220,57 @@ def test_gelu_input_helper_is_bitwise_eager_gelu_then_layer():
     assert torch.equal(fused, eager)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (torch.cuda.is_available() and comfy_kitchen_available()),
+    reason="needs CUDA and comfy_kitchen",
+)
+def test_qwen_image21_kitchen_mlp_packs_gate_up_and_folds_swiglu(monkeypatch):
+    """On comfy_kitchen the Qwen-Image 2.1 MLP runs ComfyUI's fused form; once
+    the shared gate/up storage is gone it falls back to separate projections."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.qwen_image21 import (
+        QwenImage21FeedForward,
+    )
+
+    _with_tp(monkeypatch, 1)
+    ffn = QwenImage21FeedForward(
+        1024, 3, ConvRotInt8Config(backend="comfy_kitchen"), "blocks.0.img_mlp"
+    ).cuda()
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    for layer in (ffn.gate_layer, ffn.proj, ffn.out):
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            layer.weight.copy_(
+                torch.randn(layer.weight.shape, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.02
+            )
+        out_weight = layer.weight.detach().float()  # ends as ffn.out's BF16 weight
+        layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    x = torch.randn(1, 2048, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen)
+    gate, up = ffn.gate_layer(x)[0], ffn.proj(x)[0]
+    eager = ffn.out(F.silu(gate) * up)[0]
+
+    ffn.pack_gate_up_weights()
+    assert ffn.packed_gate_up() is not None
+    assert ffn.gate_layer.weight.shape == ffn.proj.weight.shape == (3072, 1024)
+    fused = ffn(x)
+    # The fused quantizer keeps silu(gate) * up in FP32 rather than rounding it
+    # to BF16, so it is not bitwise the eager form; it must be no further (1%
+    # slack) from the FP32 down-projection of the same gate and up.
+    reference = (F.silu(gate.float()) * up.float()) @ out_weight.t()
+
+    def rel_l2(out):
+        err = torch.linalg.vector_norm(out.float() - reference)
+        return (err / torch.linalg.vector_norm(reference)).item()
+
+    assert rel_l2(fused) <= 1.01 * rel_l2(eager), (rel_l2(fused), rel_l2(eager))
+
+    # A CPU round trip rebuilds every parameter on its own; .cuda() re-packs.
+    ffn.cpu().cuda()
+    assert torch.equal(ffn(x), fused)
+
+    ffn.proj.weight.data = ffn.proj.weight.data.clone()
+    assert ffn.packed_gate_up() is None
+    assert torch.equal(ffn(x), eager)
+
+
